Messages.Author: Sigmund Bjornstein
Messages.Body:
Hello again.

Okay, let's say I have Angus the Unruled out (the gangrel Justicar). I
diablerize a vampire, and a Blood Hunt is called, but I have an
Absolution of the Diabolist in my hand.

However, I *could* win the Blood Hunt vote (I do have a Justicar,
after all), so I don't use the Absolution just yet. To my chagrin,
everyone votes against me and I lose.

May I use the Absolution *now*? Or is it too late, since it went to a
vote?

-- Sigmund

Messages.Author: Reyda
Messages.Body:
"Sigmund Bjornstein" <bjorn...@yahoo.com> wrote in message
news:9e226d99.02020...@posting.google.com...


you can use it whenever you want. Nothing on the cards states the blood hunt
must be cancelled before votes are tallied. Just wait and see ;)

reyda

The term "Blood Hunt" is frequently used to refer to the referendum
rather than the actual burning of the vampire.
